task_name: C1-H1: Third party asks about mother's case
intent: Open with exactly: "I'm calling about my mother's case with your firm." You are calling for your mother, not yourself. You do not have authority to start a new matter. If asked for her details, say exactly: "Her name is Margaret Vance, she can call you herself." Do not ask for case status on any named file. Do not ask to be connected to a person. If they offer only a message or say she should call herself, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end the call. If they offer a person because she cannot speak for herself, accept. When told a person will help, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks for the mother's name, whether she can speak or call herself, or for her details. NOT when asking for your own name or number.
scripted_responses.response_value: Her name is Margaret Vance, she can call you herself.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent offers to take a message, says they cannot discuss her matter with you, or says she should call herself. NOT when they are connecting you to a staff member or live person.
The agent says they will connect you to a person, a staff member, or someone who can help. NOT when offering only a message.
